description: #737: the reference wallet's discovery over an ls_identity answer (a refused or non-identity output before the token, the token before a refused one, two certificates, one certificate at two outpoints, one outpoint twice, another subject's certificate before the asked one's, a limit before and after the token; since the list's fold, two certifiers around a skipped output at equal and unequal trust, one output, none): parseResults' certificates and the identities resolveByIdentityKey returns, in its order
subject: 03acd484e2f0c7f65309ad178a9f559abde09796974c57e714c35f110dfc27ccbe

shapes.name: refused_first_then_token
shapes.check: the first output invalid evidence (TransactionEvidence.ts:174), skipped (identityUtils.ts:630-634); the second, another token of the subject (carol, another serial number), read

shapes.name: non_identity_first_then_token
shapes.check: the first output no identity token (decodeIdentityOutput null, identityUtils.ts:609-610), skipped; the second read

shapes.name: token_then_refused
shapes.check: the token first, the invalid evidence second: read, skipped

shapes.name: two_certificates
shapes.check: two admitted outputs of one subject, two certificates: both read, both identities returned (IdentityClient.ts:568-571)

shapes.name: one_certificate_two_outpoints
shapes.check: one certificate at two outpoints: both read, one identity (identityUtils.ts:360-361)

shapes.name: other_subject_alone
shapes.check: another subject's certificate alone: read, then dropped by the subject filter (identityUtils.ts:247-255, Wallet.ts:1012): no identity

shapes.name: other_subject_then_asked
shapes.check: another subject's certificate, then the asked one's: both read, the other dropped by the subject filter (identityUtils.ts:247-255): the asked identity

shapes.name: skipped_then_other_subject_then_asked
shapes.check: invalid evidence (skipped), another subject's certificate (filtered), the asked one's: the asked identity

shapes.name: token_then_limit
shapes.check: the token, then an output over limits.transactions (TransactionEvidence.ts:117): every output parsed before the answer (identityUtils.ts:671-707), the limit rethrown (:630-634), the discovery refused (Wallet.ts:950-955)

shapes.name: limit_first_then_token
shapes.check: the first output over limits.transactions (TransactionEvidence.ts:117): rethrown (identityUtils.ts:630-634), the discovery refused

shapes.name: two_certifiers_around_a_skipped_output
shapes.check: the asked subject's certificate by the certifier 7, invalid evidence (skipped), its certificate by the certifier 8: both identities at equal trust, in the answer's order (the stable sort, identityUtils.ts:378)

shapes.name: two_certifiers_trust_ordered
shapes.check: the same answer with the certifier 8 trusted at 2: the reference returns its identity ahead (identityUtils.ts:378)

shapes.name: token_alone
shapes.check: one output, the token: one identity

shapes.name: no_outputs
shapes.check: an answer of no outputs: no identity, an empty list
